ravenRockTunnelConflict.rule: Warehouse construction starts at z=200 or south; no excavation may enter the route protection halo.

rejectedFullEnvelope.reason: The requested full parking-footprint box intersects extensive aquifer/cave systems and the north edge intersects the protected Raven Rock route.

verticalDesign.minimumNaturalCoverBelowParking: three solid blocks, to be re-proven against the release snapshot

programZones.program: receiving, inspection, marshalling and inbound staging
fire-water, electrical, ventilation, pumps, maintenance and protected utility access
high-bay pallet and parts racks with marked pedestrian spine, lift aisles and cross aisles
cars, fleet vehicles, campers and RVs with wheel stops, charging isolation and exhaust extraction
offices, dispatch, training, records and overlook
cafeteria, commercial kitchen, dry/cold stores and wash-up; fire and air separated from vehicle/storage hall
private adult staff wellness/relief rooms, expressed non-graphically, with a privacy vestibule, independent exhaust, cleanable finishes, wash support and separation from food/work circulation

westAccessStudy.userIntent: A drivable ramp opposite the east C01 bunker portal.
westAccessStudy.simpleRampRule: x[-125,-117], z200..296, floorY=40+floor((z-200)/4), seven clear blocks above each floor

adaptiveRampResult.clearSection: nine blocks wide, seven blocks high, one-cell halo

deepTransferResult.clearanceModel: three blocks wide, nine blocks across z including halo, y35..45
deepTransferResult.warning: This proves a dry deep transfer, not a dry surface ramp. It cannot be released until a safe surface portal or a reviewed watertight/cofferdam design is selected.

postC01ParkingRecoveryEastWings.dependency: Old C01 is decommissioned, P01 is reconstructed and accepted as one uninterrupted surface parking object, and the new east C01 is commissioned.

northWing.program: isolatable receiving, service-parts and pallet-storage wing

southWing.program: isolatable fleet, camper/RV and bulk-storage wing

bulkheadConnectors.rule: Each east wing receives its own two-stage bulkhead vestibule at the x88/x89 core boundary. Exact connector cells and one-cell fluid/gravity halos must be re-proven on the release snapshot.

excludedAquiferAndLavaSeam.rule: No open excavation. Preserve a minimum five-block review halo and prove that both wing bulkheads isolate the warehouse from the seam.

postC01ParkingRecoveryEastWings.surfaceProtection: Maintain a minimum three-solid-block cover proof below every P01 driving and stall cell after excavation; settlement, support and drainage are acceptance gates.

requiredEgress: two remote protected stair/shaft discharges independent of the vehicle ramp
unobstructed illuminated exit spine separated from racks and vehicle hazards
refuge/fire compartments sized by the licensed life-safety design
no exit through the private wellness suite, kitchen, mechanical room or a lockable cage
